data.name: MappingWizard_Help
data.value:
UE4SS: install it next to the game exe, start the game, reach the main menu, then press Ctrl+Numpad 6 (.usmap) or Ctrl+Numpad 5 (.jmap). The file is written to the folder that holds UE4SS.dll. Hotkeys can be changed in Mods/Keybinds/Scripts/main.lua; the GUI 'Dumpers' tab has the same buttons.
Dumper-7: inject the DLL into the running game; the .usmap is written under {0}\<Game>\Mappings (or the SDKGenerationPath from Dumper-7.ini).
Only use these tools on games you are allowed to modify. Anti-cheat protected games may ban injected tools; that risk is yours.
